edges.reason: transfer() delegates execution to _transferFrom using msg.sender as sender.
transferFrom() performs allowance debit then delegates to _transferFrom.
_transferFrom calls contractSwap during a user transfer, performing external calls before the transfer state updates complete.
_transferFrom routes fee-taking transfers into _transferWithFees.
_transferFrom routes fee-less transfers into _transferWithoutFees.
_transferWithFees mutates _balances for sender, contract and recipient.
_transferWithoutFees mutates _balances for sender and recipient.
contractSwap invokes the external router swap with the accumulated token amount.
contractSwap invokes the external payable addLiquidityETH call.
contractSwap forwards ETH to fee wallets via .transfer().
block.timestamp is passed as the router deadline parameter, making swap execution timestamp dependent.
clearETH pays out contract ETH to msg.sender under the authorized check.
clearETH executes payable(msg.sender).transfer() with an owner-controlled percentage.
airDrop loops calling _transferWithoutFees from the owner-provided source.
approve writes the spender allowance in _allowances.
approve allows arbitrary allowance values, including max approvals.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
setFeeRatios writes the _fees struct fields.
setSwapSettings writes swapThreshold.
tradingStatus is onlyOwner and toggles tradingOpen.
tradingStatus initializes launchBlock on first enable.
setLocks writes isLocked entries for the supplied addresses.
setIsFeeExempt writes isFeeExempt entries.
setIsTxLimitExempt writes isTxLimitExempt entries.
setMaxTxAmount writes _maxTxAmount.
setFeeWallets writes the payable marketing and dev wallets.
setFeeMultipliers writes _multipliers fields.
Owner address is granted authorization in the Auth constructor.
_transferFrom reads authorizations to bypass tradingOpen and lock restrictions.
clearETH is protected by the authorized modifier reading the authorizations mapping.
msg.sender is checked against owner/authorizations in onlyOwner and authorized modifiers.
contractSwap uses the stored router for swap and liquidity calls.
_transferWithFees compares sender/recipient with pair to classify buy, sell or transfer.
_transferFrom reads inSwap to short-circuit fee logic during an ongoing swap.
swapLock modifier sets inSwap around the external-call-laden contractSwap body.
isOverLiquified queries getLiquidityBacking for the comparison.
getLiquidityBacking divides by getCirculatingSupply.
balanceOf reads _balances.
Fee wallet ETH transfers execute external callbacks while contractSwap is mid-execution.
Router swap performs an external callback into token contracts while inSwap logic runs.
amount parameter flows through the transfer entry points into _transferFrom.
recipient parameter flows through the transfer entry points into _transferFrom.
sender parameter flows through transferFrom into _transferFrom.
spender parameter flows into the approve allowance write.
Local usrAllowance is decremented by amount inside transferFrom.
Local feeAmount computed from amount, _fees and _multipliers drives the fee deduction.
Local amountAfterFees determines the recipient credit.
Local amountToSwap is the token amount passed to the router swap.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter only exists to feed the core transfer propagation function and can be folded into it.
The recipient parameter is only a destination argument of the core transfer function.
The sender parameter is only a source argument of the core transfer function.
The spender parameter is only used to index the allowance write performed by the core approve function.
Temporary allowance value is scoped entirely to the core transferFrom function.
Fee amount is a transient computation of the core fee-taking transfer function.
Post-fee remainder is a transient computation of the core fee-taking transfer function.
Amount to swap is a transient computation of the core swap routine.
